chants.vernacular_text: My heart declared to you: "Your countenance have I sought; I shall ever seek your countenance, O Lord; do not turn your face from me." ℣. The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?

Remember your mercies, Lord, and your love which is from all eternity. Do not let our enemies triumph over us; deliver us, O God of Israel, from all our tribulations. ℣. Unto you, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul; O my God, I trust in you, let me not be put to shame.
Let the nations know that God is your name; you alone are the Most High over all the earth. ℣. O my God, sweep them away like whirling dust, like chaff before the wind.
You have caused the earth to quake, O Lord, you have rent it open. ℣. Repair its breaches, for it totters. ℣. May your chosen ones escape the menacing bow and be delivered.
I will meditate on your commandments which I love exceedingly; I will lift up my hands towards your commandments which I love.
Tell no one about the vision you have seen until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.
